teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Vocab Progression
teacherNotes.content: 1. Recognition -> 2. Pronunciation -> 3. Classification -> 4. Controlled Production -> 5. Personalised Use

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: name, first name, surname, friend, colleague, this, who, what, person, mr, mrs, ms, sir, madam

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
name, first name, surname, friend, colleague, this, who, what, person, mr, mrs, ms, sir, madam
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What's your name? (asking someone's name)
• My name is... (stating name)
• Who is this? (asking identity of third person)
• This is my friend... (introducing another person)
• Is he/she...? (asking confirmation)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Question intonation: Falling pitch on Wh- questions ('What's your name?'). Rising pitch on Yes/No questions ('Is this John?').

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Question intonation: Falling pitch on Wh- questions ('What's your name?'). Rising pitch on Yes/No questions ('Is this John?').

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Questions with 'be' (Am I...? Are you...? Is he/she/it...?) and short answers (Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. / Yes, he is. / No, she isn't.).

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Questions with 'be' (Am I...? Are you...? Is he/she/it...?) and short answers (Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. / Yes, he is. / No, she isn't.).
Examples:

• What is your name?
• Is she Sarah?
• Yes, she is.
• Are you a student?
• Yes, I am.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: What's your name?
Person B: My name is...
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can ask and answer names and introduce another person.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Recycled Greetings; 10-25m Asking Names Vocab; 25-40m Questions with 'be' & Short Answers; 40-55m Third-person Introduction Roleplay; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Vocab Expansion; 25-45m Grammar Drill; 45-65m Mingle & Introduce Friends; 65-85m Dialogue Reading & Listening; 85-90m Summary.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Warm-up; 15-35m Vocab & Phonetics; 35-65m Grammar Deep Dive & Short Answers; 65-95m Group Networking Simulation; 95-115m Written Introductions; 115-120m Wrap-up.
